notes.title: The Secret of Retropolis 0.68 patch notes
notes.content: We fixed a number of small bugs and typos reported to us by the community.

notes.title: Update Note for version 0.67
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

We've fixed a bug in the game that appeared in one of our last version, where HTC Vive controllers didn't track.

We want to thank our amazing community for spotting this regression issue and helping us to solve it.
Thanks to you, this issue is also solved in our Beta for Retropolis 2.

Best,
Asaf from Peanut Button

notes.title: Subtitle Hotfix
notes.content: Fixed a couple of bugs with the game's subtitle system.

notes.title: New Languages Update
notes.content:
Hey Bots! 

The first update to The Secret of Retropolis is now live, and the major addition is UI and subtitles to many new languages: German, French, Spanish, Chinese, Korean, Japanese and Hebrew.

To stay tuned for more Retropolis news you can follow The Secret of Retropolis on Twitter or join our mailing list.

Cheers,
The Peanut Button Team

notes.title: Our demo will be available until July 21st
notes.content:
Hey everybody.

We want to thank everyone who played the Demo and gave us feedback. It's truly heartwarming to see  players connecting with the style of the game and waiting to see what happens next in the story. For those who didn't play it yet, the demo will be playable until the full game releases on July 21st.

And for those who missed our Steam Next Fest livestreams, we're attaching the recording at the bottom of this announcement. 

There were two issues that were brought to our attention regarding the demo:
1. The mirror in Philip's office is pixelated, and slows down frame rate on lower end machines - we came up with a fix that will be included in the full game.
2. On the knuckles controllers - resting the hand on the grip button prevents interacting at the same time - we're currently working on a revised controller binding that solves this for the demo as well as the full game.

If you're experiencing any other issues, technical or other, let us know in the community hub. :)

Last but not least, we wanted to let you know that tomorrow we'll be posting some major news about the game's release on July 21st. Join our mailing list so you don't miss them (and get free Retropolis digital posters).

Take care,
The Peanut Button crew.

notes.title: The Release Date of Retropolis
notes.content:
We've been hard at work to polish all the rough edges around our beloved VR adventure, and after thorough beta-testing we're excited to announce that...

*Suspenseful music*
...
*Drum rolls*
...


The Secret of Retropolis will be releasing July 21st!

Yes, it's true. The game is launch is right around the corner.
If you hate spoilers like we do, this announcement should help you to plan ahead and play before everyone else.
A great way to get a friendly reminder prior to the online spoiler tsunami is to join our mailing list.
We're celebrating the release date announcement by giving 2 new exclusive Retropolis digital posters to anyone joining our mailing list. So don't miss out on those either :-)


Join the mailing list and get your free posters!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37957281/3668641e732a335323c1d0d50b221267667932cd.png
And if you're at it, you can reply to the welcome email and chat with us. Any contact with players in the weeks leading to our first game launch is more than welcome.

Take care all,
Asaf from Peanut Button
